title: Design
description: Design as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Is the design concept defined and traceable to its allocated Requirements?
Are the main design options and the reasons for the chosen option recorded?
Are design risks identified and recorded as Risks or Actions?
Is the preliminary design sized and laid out in the integrated model?
Are the applicable TSMs identified and their applicable statements understood?
Are open design Actions from stage A closed or planned?
Is the detail design complete and every Part and Assembly definition ready for release?
Is conformance claimed against every applicable TSM statement, with evidence?
Are all Actions from reviews A, B and C closed before release?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
